implemented: Same action-independent state encoder at both endpoints; queried action belongs to the edge.
Finite goal regression with exists-action/all-observed-outcomes semantics and live per-step observation checks.
Unknown actions are explicit experiments; observed routes can lead to an unobserved action.
Conflicting observed continuations earn bounded action-history refinement; exhausted language remains UNKNOWN.
Historical evidence, revocations and residuals serialize and survive resets; revoked supports trigger reclosure.
Actual standalone agent and notebook bundle the pinned core and new controller; no LLM runtime.
implementation.authority_boundary: Observed occurrences are warranted only in the historical sample. Future replay/composition is CANDIDATE, not certified unseen dynamics. Exact normalized observations plus earned bounded history are conservative state identities, not a learned minimal visual quotient.

verification.actual_framework_fixture: bt33: three levels reached by delivered MyAgent
verification.finite_scope: Finite observed models only, not unseen dynamics or ARC generalization.

public_evaluation.scope: All 25 accessible public catalogue games frozen before play; one independent episode per arm/game. Public development only, not sealed holdout or Kaggle score.
public_evaluation.attribution_boundary: Both arms inherit the same trace bank. The ar25 extra level and ft09 partial-progress efficiency gain do not establish newly learned semantic transfer. Both arms still consumed the full total evaluation budget. All games and failures are retained.

finite_stream.scope: 128 opaque relabelings times three lives; synthetic path worlds, not ARC score or cross-mechanic generalization.

api_test_fixtures.scope: Two official API test fixtures, three lives each; not competition games.

negative_result.statement: When current level L equals the highest observed level and no WIN state has been observed, the goal seed (observed levels greater than L or WIN) is empty. Every live action group has at least one successor, so least predecessor closure remains empty. This learned goal planner cannot act on first arrival at that new maximum level.
negative_result.boundary: Finite observed graph and this exact goal definition. This is not a universal impossibility theorem or an exclusive explanation for every failure.
negative_result.consequence: Reset replay can reuse old absolute goals; it does not supply a goal-relative reusable procedure for a new context. Learned goal-planner use was zero in all 25 public first episodes.
other_residuals: Exact observation identity is not a minimal future quotient.
Observed consistency does not certify unobserved transitions.
Aggregate real play-loop wall time regressed.

next_gate.objective: Goal-relative applicability transport, not more count-only banking.
next_gate.experiment: Acquire a procedure in an earlier context, compile a relative progress postcondition and explicit observation/action bindings, invoke it in a new context before that context has reached its goal, and verify actual progress with an empty-memory ablation. Reuse existing ROS adapter/capability machinery. No game-specific dispatch, hidden labels, or omitted failures.
next_gate.promotion: Nonzero learned capability use and improvement on prospective contexts, then frozen whole-agent sealed evaluation with all interaction and compute costs reported.
